column1: # Checkpoint evaluation set. NOT needed to run the game -- pull this only to
# re-run docs/model-evaluation.md.
# Format: <target path under /models>
# ~29 GB on top of the SDXL set. Every file size below was read from the
# Hugging Face API, not estimated.
# LICENCES DIFFER AND THEY ARE NOT A FOOTNOTE. Two of these four cannot ship in a
# monetised product. They are still worth measuring -- evaluating is not
# distributing -- but see docs/model-evaluation.md before choosing one.
# Booru-adjacent dialect with its own score_N prefix convention, so it needs its
# own positivePrefix in a pack. Modified Fair AI Public License 1.0-SD:
# inference is not permitted in applications allowing any form of monetisation,
# with named exceptions for CivitAI and Hugging Face.
checkpoints/ponyDiffusionV6XL.safetensors
# Full Danbooru + e621, eps-prediction. The eps build rather than the v-pred one
# deliberately: v-pred needs ModelSamplingDiscrete in the graph, and a comparison
# that changes the sampler alongside the checkpoint measures two things at once.
# fair-ai-public-license-1.0-sd: commercialisation prohibited.
checkpoints/NoobAI-XL-v1.1.safetensors
# Apache 2.0, and the only candidate here with no commercial restriction at all.
# Not a checkpoint: ComfyUI loads it as diffusion model + text encoder + VAE, so
# it needs its own workflow rather than CheckpointLoaderSimple. Note the real
# size -- "4B" is the diffusion model alone, and the text encoder is a whole
# Qwen3-4B on top of it. 7.75 + 8.04 + 0.34 = 16.1 GB, or 11.9 GB with the fp4
# encoder, which is why the 12 GB profile cannot host this.
# It also accepts no negative prompt: guidance is distilled into the model, so
# there is no unconditional pass for a negative embedding to attach to. The
# pack's alwaysNegative terms would be inert here. See docs/decisions.md.
diffusion_models/flux-2-klein-4b.safetensors
text_encoders/qwen_3_4b.safetensors
vae/flux2-vae.safetensors
# Apache 2.0 for the transformer, and by far the smallest candidate. Its text
# encoder is Gemma-2-2b-it under the Gemma licence, which this project is
# already subject to because the LLM tier is Gemma 4.
# REQUIRES INSTALL_EXTRA_MODELS=1. ComfyUI 0.34.2 on this box exposes no Sana
# nodes at all -- verified against /object_info, not assumed -- so Sana needs
# city96/ComfyUI_ExtraModels, a third-party pack running inside the ComfyUI
# process. That is a supply-chain decision, which is why it is opt-in.
# Sana is trained for general photoreal and text rendering rather than anime, so
# expect it to lose on style. It is in the mix because the age-legibility test is
# style-agnostic and a 3.2 GB model that passes it would change the 12 GB budget
# completely.
sana/transformer.safetensors
sana/vae.safetensors
text_encoders/gemma-2-2b-it.safetensors
# Deliberately left commented out. It is the quality ceiling of the FLUX family
# that fits on a 32 GB card at all, but:
#   * the diffusion weights come from black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-9B, which is
#     gated -- set HF_TOKEN and accept the terms before uncommenting;
#   * non-commercial licence, so it can never ship;
#   * the text encoder alone is Qwen3-8B: 16.4 GB at bf16, 8.7 GB at fp8mixed.
# Uncomment only to answer "how much are we giving up by staying small", and
# expect roughly 27 GB of download for an answer you cannot act on.
# text_encoders/qwen_3_8b_fp8mixed.safetensors
